findings.issue: Task 4 Details section says FunnelExecutionEngine injects StepExecutor to describe the cycle, but the actual injection is indirect — FunnelExecutionEngine drives StepExecutor via a method call (StepExecutor is a @Component injected into FunnelExecutionEngine, confirmed by StepExecutor.java line 43 and FunnelExecutionEngine.java). The cycle description is functionally correct but the phrasing 'FunnelExecutionEngine → StepExecutor' implies a constructor-injection edge; the actual edge is FunnelExecutionEngine injects StepExecutor (confirmed). No impact on implementation — the cycle and the factory fix are correctly identified.
findings.fix: Informational only — no change needed. The bean cycle is real and the factory fix is correct.

findings.issue: Task 4 TDD Anchor references 'FunnelEventServiceIT::fanout_oneFiringStartsNExecutions — proves the Task-1 index relax'. This IT will require the Task-2 startup migration to have run (to actually drop the old index); without it, two active non-on_start funnels with the same triggerValue will be blocked by the existing unique index. The task does not call out this coupling explicitly in the TDD Anchor (only in the Edge case section). If Task 4's IT runs before Task 2 merges, the fan-out IT will fail for the wrong reason.
findings.fix: Add a note to the TDD Anchor that the fan-out IT depends on Task 2's migration having run (same note already exists in Task 1's IT section — mirror it in Task 4's TDD Anchor).
